A shopper goes to a pet store to buy dog food and treats. The shopper has $20. Each can of food costs $1.87, and each bag of treats costs $2.37. Which inequality represents the relationship between the number of cans of food, c, and the number of bags of treats, t, the shopper can buy?
questions.verified: cost per can 1.87 pairs with c; total cannot exceed 20

questions.stem: \[0=(x-k)(7x+t)-(x-k)\]In the given equation, k and t are positive constants. A solution to the equation is \(-\frac{22}{7}\). What is the value of t?
In the figure, line q is parallel to line r, and both lines are intersected by line s. If \(y=2x+9\), what is the value of x?
questions.needsFigure: two parallel lines cut by a transversal, source page 79
questions.CONFLICT: The official key says A (26), which requires y=61. But the figure (zoomed and checked) puts 61 deg at the UPPER-RIGHT angle of line q and y deg at the UPPER-LEFT angle of line r. Those are supplementary, not equal, so y=119 and x=55 (choice C). The student who took the test also selected C. My derivation and the key disagree, so this question is EXCLUDED from the Test 5 build rather than shipped with a doubtful answer.

questions.stem: If \(f(x)=x+2\) and \(g(x)=2x\), what is the value of \(6f(3)-g(3)\)?
\[y=5x+7\]\[y=-4x-11\]The solution to the given system of equations is (x,y). What is the value of y?

To study fluctuations in leaf water potential, samples of wood were taken from 27 trees and cut in the shape of a cube. The length of the edge of one of these cubes is 3.000 centimeters. This cube has a density of 0.170 grams per cubic centimeter. What is the mass of this cube, in grams?

A plumbing company charges its customers $112 for the first hour of a plumbing service call and $40 for each additional hour, plus the cost of plumbing parts. Which equation represents the total cost y, in dollars, for an x-hour plumbing service call where the cost of parts was $z and \(x\ge 1\)?
Circle A has equation \((x-7)^{2}+(y+3)^{2}=1\). In the xy-plane, circle B is obtained by translating circle A to the right 4 units. Which equation represents circle B?
questions.verified: centre (7,-3) shifts right 4 to (11,-3); radius unchanged

questions.stem: A certain open star cluster contains M-type stars and K-type stars. The estimated total mass of M-type and K-type stars in this open star cluster is 129,492 quettagrams. The graph shown models the possible combinations of the number of M-type stars, x, and the number of K-type stars, y, that could be in this open star cluster if all the M-type stars have the same estimated mass and all the K-type stars have the same estimated mass. Based on the graph, which of the following is closest to the estimated mass, in quettagrams, of each M-type star in this cluster?
questions.needsFigure: line graph, K-type vs M-type star counts, source page 86
questions.verified: at the x-intercept all mass is M-type: 129492/156 = 830.1, closest to 830

questions.stem: The positive number a is 3,700% of the number c, and c is 20% of the number b. If \(a-b=wc\), where w is a constant, what is the value of w?

An object is launched into the air from ground level. According to a quadratic model, 2.1 seconds after the object is launched, it reaches its maximum height of 70.56 feet above ground level. Which equation represents this model, where f(t) is the object's height, in feet, above ground level t seconds after it was launched?
questions.verified: vertex (2.1, 70.56) needs (t-2.1); a maximum needs a negative leading coefficient

questions.verified: B gives 3x-3 = 3x+3 -> -3=3, contradiction. A is an identity; C and D each give x=1

questions.stem: The volume of a right rectangular prism with a square base is 539 cubic centimeters. If the area of each of the four lateral faces is 77 square centimeters, what is the height, in centimeters, of the prism?
questions.verified: s^2*h=539 and s*h=77; dividing gives s=7, so h=77/7=11

questions.stem: A science class studied the feeding behavior of the birds that visited a bird feeder each school day for a period of time. The table summarizes the number of birds the class observed visiting the bird feeder each school day during this period of time. What is the median number of birds the class observed visiting the bird feeder each school day during this period of time?
questions.verified: 23 days total; median is the 12th value; cumulative counts 3,6,10,11,14,23 put the 12th in the 18-bird group

questions.stem: The graph of \(y=f(x)+2\) is shown. Which equation defines function f?
questions.CONFLICT: The key says D. Reading the plotted curve at four lattice points gives y(0)=4, y(1)=3, y(2)=1, y(3)=-3 with an x-intercept near 2.35, which is exactly y=-2^x+5. Since the plotted curve IS y=f(x)+2, f(x) = -2^x+3, i.e. choice B. Choice D would require the plotted curve to be -2^x+7, whose y-intercept is 6 -- the graph plainly shows 4. Likely the key author read the plotted curve off as f itself. EXCLUDED from the build.

questions.stem: \[f(x)=5x^{2}+60x+181\]The function g is defined by \(g(x)=f(x+8)\). What is the minimum value of g(x)?
questions.verified: vertex of f at x=-6, f(-6)=1; a horizontal translation does not change the minimum VALUE, so min g = 1

questions.stem: In a set of four consecutive odd integers, where the integers are ordered from least to greatest, the first integer is represented by x. The product of 28 and the third odd integer in the set is at most the value of 50 less than the sum of the first and fourth odd integers in the set. What is the greatest possible value of x?
questions.verified: integers x, x+2, x+4, x+6; 28(x+4) <= (x + x+6) - 50 -> 26x <= -156 -> x <= -6; greatest odd value is -7

questions.stem: \[-2x^{2}+bx-32=0\]In the given equation, b is a positive integer. The equation has no real solution. What is the largest possible value of b?
questions.verified: no real solution needs discriminant b^2-4(-2)(-32) = b^2-256 < 0, so b < 16; largest positive integer is 15

questions.stem:
The functions f and g are defined by the equations shown, where a and b are integer constants, \(a<b\) and \(b<0\). If \(y=f(x)\) and \(y=g(x)\) are graphed in the xy-plane, which of the following equations displays, as a constant or coefficient, the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of the graph of the corresponding function?
I. \(f(x)=a(3.3)^{x+b}\)
II. \(g(x)=a(3.3)^{x}+b\)
questions.verified: f(0)=a(3.3)^b and g(0)=a+b; neither value appears literally as a constant or coefficient in its equation

questions.stem: \[\frac{1}{cx}=\frac{x}{76}+\frac{1}{c}\]In the given equation, c is a constant. If the equation has exactly one solution, what is the value of c?
questions.verified: multiply by cx: cx^2+76x-76=0; exactly one solution needs 76^2+4*76*c = 0 -> c = -19
questions.NOTE: The denominator reads 76, not 70 -- only legible after zooming the low-resolution capture. 70 would give c=-17.5 and disagree with the key.
